title: Configuring the Okta Workforce Identity Connector

blocks.text: The Okta Workforce Identity connector integrates with your Okta platform to retrieve crucial identity and device data for use within the Agentic SOC application in the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform). This allows Agentic SOC to detect and respond to identity-based threats, including credential compromise. It retrieves system log activity (e.g., application, device, group, system, user authentication, user lifecycle, user multi-factor authentication (MFA), and zone activity) from Okta as telemetry and analyzes this data for suspicious activity.

To configure the Okta Workforce Identity connector, ensure you have active Internet & SaaS (ZIA) and Agentic SOC accounts. You also need the source authentication configuration. The following parameters are required for the specific authentication you select:

blocks.item: Token Hostname
The Token Hostname authentication type requires the following parameters:
Token
Hostname
To generate an API token, refer to the Okta documentation or see the Zscaler and Okta Deployment Guide.
Okta OAuth 2.0
The Okta OAuth 2.0 authentication requires the following parameters:
Domain
Client ID
Private Key
Key ID
To create a public and private OAuth 2.0 key, refer to the Okta documentation.

blocks.text: To create the Okta Workforce Identity data source in the Agentic SecOps Platform:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Sources.
Click Create.
The Create New Data Source page appears.
On the Create New Data Source page, search for and select the Okta Workforce Identity connector tile from the available data sources.
See image.

blocks.text: After you create the Okta Workforce Identity data source, enter the following information in the source setup Retrieval section:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
The Okta Users Authentication window appears.
In the Okta Users Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
See image.
Click Create.
After the data source is saved, you can't change its authentication. To use a different authentication, delete the existing data source and create a new one.

blocks.text: To learn more, see Configuring Authentication for Data Sources and Outegrations and Managing Authentication for Data Sources and Outegrations. For complete configuration instructions, see Creating Data Sources.
